units.rawText: The demolished rubble has been excavated. Nameless watches the two Dolls which have been rescued from it, his face unreadable.
units.displayText: The demolished rubble has been excavated. Nameless watches the two Dolls which have been rescued from it, his face unreadable.

spans.text: The demolished rubble has been excavated. Nameless watches the two Dolls which have been rescued from it, his face unreadable.

units.rawText: So you're telling me that you did not, in fact, set off a bomb here just now, but instead you used an ancient pressure cooker to grill fish, causing it to explode.
units.displayText: So you're telling me that you did not, in fact, set off a bomb here just now, but instead you used an ancient pressure cooker to grill fish, causing it to explode.

spans.text: So you're telling me that you did not, in fact, set off a bomb here just now, but instead you used an ancient pressure cooker to grill fish, causing it to explode.

units.rawText: Could you please not repeat that every single time? My intellect modules take a hit every time I hear it.
units.displayText: Could you please not repeat that every single time? My intellect modules take a hit every time I hear it.

spans.text: Could you please not repeat that every single time? My intellect modules take a hit every time I hear it.

units.rawText: Recording unplanned actions is a basic principle, lest you end up being flagged as an Irregular Agent.
units.displayText: Recording unplanned actions is a basic principle, lest you end up being flagged as an Irregular Agent.

spans.text: Recording unplanned actions is a basic principle, lest you end up being flagged as an Irregular Agent.

units.rawText: Let's take you, for example. Your insistence on staying in a sector to which you are not native is one of the hallmarks of an Irregular Agent.
units.displayText: Let's take you, for example. Your insistence on staying in a sector to which you are not native is one of the hallmarks of an Irregular Agent.

spans.text: Let's take you, for example. Your insistence on staying in a sector to which you are not native is one of the hallmarks of an Irregular Agent.

units.rawText: Eh!? Wait a minute, Gin's not a local either, right? So why am I the only one you're trying to chase away?
units.displayText: Eh!? Wait a minute, Gin's not a local either, right? So why am I the only one you're trying to chase away?

spans.text: Eh!? Wait a minute, Gin's not a local either, right? So why am I the only one you're trying to chase away?

units.rawText: The Oasis and Cyclopes have signed a mutual cooperation pact, and as a member of the Oasis on dispatch, I have the right to be stationed here.
units.displayText: The Oasis and Cyclopes have signed a mutual cooperation pact, and as a member of the Oasis on dispatch, I have the right to be stationed here.

spans.text: The Oasis and Cyclopes have signed a mutual cooperation pact, and as a member of the Oasis on dispatch, I have the right to be stationed here.

units.rawText: Then I can apply for that permission too! I can even help perform file restoration and rebuild the sector!
units.displayText: Then I can apply for that permission too! I can even help perform file restoration and rebuild the sector!

spans.text: Then I can apply for that permission too! I can even help perform file restoration and rebuild the sector!

units.rawText: Even so...
units.displayText: Even so...

spans.text: Even so...

units.rawText: Are you still going to drive away a folklore researcher even after seeing the current state of the Cyclopes Sector?
units.displayText: Are you still going to drive away a folklore researcher even after seeing the current state of the Cyclopes Sector?

spans.text: Are you still going to drive away a folklore researcher even after seeing the current state of the Cyclopes Sector?

units.rawText: Nameless furrows his brows and subconsciously looks at the ruins around him, as well as the agents working upon them.
units.displayText: Nameless furrows his brows and subconsciously looks at the ruins around him, as well as the agents working upon them.

spans.text: Nameless furrows his brows and subconsciously looks at the ruins around him, as well as the agents working upon them.

units.rawText: ...What are you getting at?
units.displayText: ...What are you getting at?

spans.text: ...What are you getting at?

units.rawText: Cyclopes is currently rebuilding after a disaster, right? Well, given what I've seen on the way in, it's less "rebuilding" than "bulldozing the ruins and building anew on top of them".
units.displayText: Cyclopes is currently rebuilding after a disaster, right? Well, given what I've seen on the way in, it's less "rebuilding" than "bulldozing the ruins and building anew on top of them".

spans.text: Cyclopes is currently rebuilding after a disaster, right? Well, given what I've seen on the way in, it's less "rebuilding" than "bulldozing the ruins and building anew on top of them".

units.rawText: If you don't take any appropriate measures to protect or preserve the ruins, won't that mean that the rebuilt Cyclopes Sector will have nothing in common with the old sector other than informational data?
units.displayText: If you don't take any appropriate measures to protect or preserve the ruins, won't that mean that the rebuilt Cyclopes Sector will have nothing in common with the old sector other than informational data?

spans.text: If you don't take any appropriate measures to protect or preserve the ruins, won't that mean that the rebuilt Cyclopes Sector will have nothing in common with the old sector other than informational data?

units.rawText: It's different for me. Whether it's data preservation, restoration or scenery recreation, a cultural expert like me is the most professional person for the job!
units.displayText: It's different for me. Whether it's data preservation, restoration or scenery recreation, a cultural expert like me is the most professional person for the job!

spans.text: It's different for me. Whether it's data preservation, restoration or scenery recreation, a cultural expert like me is the most professional person for the job!

units.rawText: The Cyclopes Sector doesn't need any of these. Agents don't care about the past...
units.displayText: The Cyclopes Sector doesn't need any of these. Agents don't care about the past...

spans.text: The Cyclopes Sector doesn't need any of these. Agents don't care about the past...

units.rawText: Nameless suddenly stops speaking, as though he's thought of something, and then he glances to the side.
units.displayText: Nameless suddenly stops speaking, as though he's thought of something, and then he glances to the side.

spans.text: Nameless suddenly stops speaking, as though he's thought of something, and then he glances to the side.

units.rawText: (Hm? I don't know if I spoke a key phrase or something, but I get the feeling that I've triggered something!)
units.displayText: Hm? I don't know if I spoke a key phrase or something, but I get the feeling that I've triggered something!

spans.text: Hm? I don't know if I spoke a key phrase or something, but I get the feeling that I've triggered something!

units.rawText: Preserving the past, recording history, rescuing civilization, attempting to restore the original appearance of ruins... That is a cultural expert's calling!
units.displayText: Preserving the past, recording history, rescuing civilization, attempting to restore the original appearance of ruins... That is a cultural expert's calling!

spans.text: Preserving the past, recording history, rescuing civilization, attempting to restore the original appearance of ruins... That is a cultural expert's calling!

units.rawText: No matter how you slice it, you wouldn't go to the shop to buy something new if you could mend a familiar household item, right? It'd be expensive and hard to use.
units.displayText: No matter how you slice it, you wouldn't go to the shop to buy something new if you could mend a familiar household item, right? It'd be expensive and hard to use.

spans.text: No matter how you slice it, you wouldn't go to the shop to buy something new if you could mend a familiar household item, right? It'd be expensive and hard to use.

units.rawText: But you...
units.displayText: But you...

spans.text: But you...

units.rawText: Nameless groans quietly. He seems to have been shaken.
units.displayText: Nameless groans quietly. He seems to have been shaken.

spans.text: Nameless groans quietly. He seems to have been shaken.

units.rawText: Also, I won't spend too long here! I'll go once I fix Little Si.
units.displayText: Also, I won't spend too long here! I'll go once I fix Little Si.

spans.text: Also, I won't spend too long here! I'll go once I fix Little Si.

units.rawText: I told you before, right? Without Little Si, I have essentially zero fighting power without an agent to assist me.
units.displayText: I told you before, right? Without Little Si, I have essentially zero fighting power without an agent to assist me.

spans.text: I told you before, right? Without Little Si, I have essentially zero fighting power without an agent to assist me.

units.rawText: If you had to help an allied agent who can't fight to leave the sector, you'd have to send someone along with them, right?
units.displayText: If you had to help an allied agent who can't fight to leave the sector, you'd have to send someone along with them, right?

spans.text: If you had to help an allied agent who can't fight to leave the sector, you'd have to send someone along with them, right?

units.rawText: In that case, why not have them help me fix Little Si, and I can help you fix the sector too. It's a win-win situation!
units.displayText: In that case, why not have them help me fix Little Si, and I can help you fix the sector too. It's a win-win situation!

spans.text: In that case, why not have them help me fix Little Si, and I can help you fix the sector too. It's a win-win situation!

units.rawText: ...Got it.
units.displayText: ...Got it.

spans.text: ...Got it.

units.rawText: Nameless' slightly unfocused electronic pupils sharpen up again.
units.displayText: Nameless' slightly unfocused electronic pupils sharpen up again.

spans.text: Nameless' slightly unfocused electronic pupils sharpen up again.

units.rawText: In keeping with the mutual assistance pact between the Cyclopes Sector and the Oasis, I will help you repair your agent accessory "Little Si", while you will need to help us rebuild the sector.
units.displayText: In keeping with the mutual assistance pact between the Cyclopes Sector and the Oasis, I will help you repair your agent accessory "Little Si", while you will need to help us rebuild the sector.

spans.text: In keeping with the mutual assistance pact between the Cyclopes Sector and the Oasis, I will help you repair your agent accessory "Little Si", while you will need to help us rebuild the sector.

units.rawText: Once the repairs are complete and the agent accessory can function normally, I will escort you out of the Cyclopes Sector.
units.displayText: Once the repairs are complete and the agent accessory can function normally, I will escort you out of the Cyclopes Sector.

spans.text: Once the repairs are complete and the agent accessory can function normally, I will escort you out of the Cyclopes Sector.

units.rawText: Any objections?
units.displayText: Any objections?

spans.text: Any objections?

units.rawText: Why are you so eager to chase me away, anyway...
units.displayText: Why are you so eager to chase me away, anyway...

spans.text: Why are you so eager to chase me away, anyway...

units.rawText: Alright, that'll do.
units.displayText: Alright, that'll do.

spans.text: Alright, that'll do.

units.rawText: Give me five.
units.displayText: Give me five.

spans.text: Give me five.

units.displayText: Nameless slowly raises his arm, pausing twice along the way because he doesn't understand the meaning of the gesture.

units.displayText: Zangyin doesn't seem bothered by it and swiftly claps her hand against Nameless' palm.

spans.text: Zangyin doesn't seem bothered by it and swiftly claps her hand against Nameless' palm.

units.rawText: Clap.

units.rawText: It's a deal!
units.displayText: It's a deal!

units.rawText: I'll send someone to help rebuild the bar afterwards. You and I will go look for Liv... For the administrator in order to apply for permission to stay, as well as solving the problem of your Little Si.
